notes.title: November 13th Update Notes
notes.notes: Now you can use magic stones to modify weapon properties. Different types of magic stones have different effects. At the same time, magic stones of the same level can be synthesized to obtain higher-level magic stones. In addition, 2 leaderboards and optimized package operations have been added, and some bugs have been fixed.
